title: Clawd X Digest
summary: AI Infrastructure: Significant breakthroughs in model training at xAI and massive 99% price reductions in token caching costs are fundamentally reshaping the economics of AGI development.
Sports Economics: Anthony Gordon's €80m pursuit by Barcelona is triggering complex wage resets for Premier League stars, highlighting the financial interdependence of top-tier clubs.
Engineering Culture: The 'invisible engineer' phenomenon and the launch of Antigravity 2.0 signal a dual shift toward both acknowledging legacy risks and adopting autonomous development tools.
Human Interest: Powerful narratives from Edinson Cavani’s secret philanthropy to Jane Newton's historical impact underscore the enduring value of individual compassion in global culture.
European Football: Crystal Palace completes a historic transformation, securing a Conference League title and marking a three-trophy year for the club under Oliver Glasner.
